package.name: g1_nav_overlay
package.description: Nav2/slam_toolbox configuration for the G1's Track A kinematic virtual base: nav2_g1.yaml (base, ported from vendor/home2's nav2_omni.yaml) + nav2_g1_sim_overlay.yaml (sim deltas, deep-merged at launch), bridge_gz.yaml (ros_gz_bridge config), mapper_params_sim.yaml (localization) and mapper_params_mapping.yaml (mapping). See docs/plan.md.
